title: Claude Code Getting Started: The Complete Setup Guide (Mac, Windows, Linux)
summary: Complete Claude Code setup guide for Mac, Windows, and Linux — install, configure API keys, create CLAUDE.md, and run your first agentic coding session step by step.
body_markdown: Claude.ai is the web chat interface — you type questions and have a conversation. Claude Code is a terminal agent — it executes tasks in your actual codebase, reads files, runs commands, and makes changes. They use the same underlying Claude models but Claude Code has tools (file system access, terminal execution) that Claude.ai does not. Use Claude.ai for questions and reasoning; use Claude Code for actual coding work.
